content.comment_body: Hello, I need some assistance. In the attached program, C1 increases the counter value and C2 decreases it. What changes are needed to keep the previous count even after cycling the power? Currently, every time power is turned off and then back on, the counter resets to its initial value. Thank you, [user_name]
The counter can be configured to remember its value. Right-click on the block and check its properties. Enable the retentivity setting to achieve this.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is having trouble preserving the counter value after a power cycle in their automation program. They are not aware of the existing feature for value retention, suggesting that this capability is either not obvious or familiar to users.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a simple way to retain the counter's value following a power cycle and is seeking instructions on how to activate this feature.
